correctness.rationale: The four palindrome classes indexed by zero, one, two and three marker symbols are exhaustive for w=0^a1 0^b1 0^c1 0^d; distinguishing b=c from b!=c yields D=0 or max(0,min(a,d)-max(b,c)). The exact defect-r layer follows by choosing the longer inner gap m, shorter gap ell<m, and outer gaps m+r+x,m+r+y with min(x,y)=0. This yields 2z^(6+2r)(1+z)/((1-z)(1-z^3)(1-z^4)); summing yields the rational joint generating series. Pole/Riemann-sum analysis gives the atom 5/6, density (1-2t)^2 on (0,1/2), mean 1/48 and variance 43/11520. Independent palindrome-set enumeration checked all weight-three words n=3..15; this is finite corroboration, not proof.
